_capture_meta.verdict: 🚨 CRITICAL DIVERGENCE — every regional field is a hardcoded US default, ignoring (a) the PABSON tenant Workspace Settings and (b) the school root entity's own Asia/Kathmandu / ne-NP / bikram_sambat values. This endpoint is a separate keyspace from both, and it is not Ed-Fi-aligned (Ed-Fi v6 has no such 'school configuration' construct — regional concerns belong on EducationOrganization or the LEA).
violations: timezone='America/New_York' (tenant settings: Asia/Kathmandu; school root: Asia/Kathmandu)
gradingScale.type='letter' with A-F bands (Nepal/CEHRD uses percentage GPA; PABSON archetype default not applied)
schoolDays=[1,2,3,4,5] = Mon-Fri (Nepal week is Sun-Fri per tenant defaultWeekStartsOn=sunday)
startTime='08:00', endTime='15:30' — fine as defaults but ignored archetype hours
features.parentPortal=false but tenant features.parentPortal=true (mismatch with tier capabilities)
_capture_meta.claudemd_rule_violation: Per CLAUDE.md § Archetype model: 'Regional settings (currency, timezone, calendar, locale, number format, week start) live ONLY on WorkspaceSettings at the tenant level. School entities MUST NOT override them.' This sub-resource is overriding all of them with US defaults.
